Bollettino dell'Unione Matematica Italiana 16 (2023), 25–41; version of record published 2022-05-07; DOI 10.1007/s40574-022-00325-9.

reviews.checked_passages: Arithmetic computation entry audit: full section 2, Primitive recursive functions; selected section 3 through Proposition 3.4, arithmetization and syntax constructors. The PA/Q language, Sigma-one graphs, uniform existence and uniqueness, nonstandard defining-equation qualification, graph abbreviations and constructor conventions were checked. Later model-within-model constructions and provability-logic results were not audited.
reviews.outcome: No serious mathematical defect found in the inspected scope. The uniform representation theorem is stated using beta coding, without its full internal sequence-extension and normalization proof; this is a coverage limit, not a source error. The entry supplies the internal common-multiple, bounded CRT, history-extension and witness-collection arguments. The source explicitly warns that external equality of primitive-recursive presentations does not imply agreement at nonstandard inputs without PA-provable comparison. Its syntax numbering is not adopted; the entry retains the corpus's square-pair and certified-proof codes.
